reader_sentence: Integrated gradients tracks ablation effects much more closely than the other attribution methods (Spearman ρ ≈ 0.8–0.9 across GPT-2 small, Pythia-410M, and Gemma-2-2B), followed by attribution patching (~0.6), gradient × input (~0.45), saliency (~0.3), and activation magnitude (~0.2), and this ranking holds across all three models.
intended: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
reason: It states that integrated gradients best matches ablation on all three models (~0.8–0.9), clearly ahead of attribution patching (~0.6); the added detail on the other methods doesn't contradict the intended finding.
